title: Identity groups and permissions
help: Permissions from all of a user's groups are combined. You may manage groups only within your own granted permissions. Operator accounts are independent of groups and always have full access.
deleteConfirm: Delete "{name}"? Groups with members cannot be deleted. Reassign their members first.
name: Group name
keyHint: Start with a lowercase letter; use letters, digits or underscores
invalidGroup: Enter a name and valid key: start with a lowercase letter, up to 64 letters, digits or underscores.
saveFailed: Could not save. Check your permissions and the entered values, then try again.
membershipHelp: The system assigns the base guest or member identity automatically. Select additional groups here; permissions from all groups are combined.
operatorSeparate: Operators do not belong to groups. Operator access cannot be granted or removed here.
selfReadonly: You cannot change your own groups here, to prevent losing administrative access.
accessDenied: Your current identity does not have permission to perform this action.
